title: Checked Bag Coverage by Subscription — Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions
content:
The checked-bag benefit of Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions is set per subscription by five figures: how many checked bags are covered for each covered traveler in each direction, the heaviest bag covered, the itinerary classes on which bags are covered, and whether overweight and oversize charges are covered. Weight above the limit is charged under the Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand rules.

## Benefit sheet

| Subscription | Checked bags covered per covered traveler per direction | Heaviest bag covered (lb) | Itinerary classes on which bags are covered | Overweight charges covered | Oversize charges covered |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Bag Pass One | 1 | 50 | Domestic; short-haul international | No | No |
| Crestline Bag Pass Two | 2 | 50 | Domestic; short-haul international | No | No |
| Crestline Seat Pass Domestic | 0 | 0 | None | No | No |
| Crestline Seat Pass Network | 0 | 0 | None | No | No |
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Domestic | 1 | 50 | Domestic | No | No |
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Network | 2 | 50 | Domestic; short-haul international; long-haul international | No | No |

## Itinerary class at a glance

| Itinerary class | Subscriptions covering bags on it |
|---|---|
| Domestic | Bag Pass One, Bag Pass Two, Seat and Bag Pass Domestic, Seat and Bag Pass Network |
| Short-haul international | Bag Pass One, Bag Pass Two, Seat and Bag Pass Network |
| Long-haul international | Seat and Bag Pass Network only |

The two Seat Passes cover no checked bags on any itinerary: their bag count and weight limit are both 0.

## Reading the sheet (hypothetical bags)

- A 48 lb bag is within the 50 lb limit of every subscription that covers bags; a 50 lb bag is at the limit and within it; a 53 lb bag is above it, and the weight above the limit is charged under the Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand rules.
- No subscription covers overweight charges or oversize charges, so those charges stay payable for every tier.
- A holder of Bag Pass Two travelling on a long-haul international itinerary has no bag coverage on it, because that tier's itinerary classes are domestic and short-haul international only.
